# Veyago

> An independent New York studio (Veyago Inc., a New York C-Corporation) that ships
> privacy-first iOS apps and builds fast, hand-written websites, dashboards and CRMs
> for small businesses. Two people, no account managers, fixed prices in writing.

Two lines of work sit under one bar. The apps are private by design: on-device where
it can be, no ad trackers, no dark patterns, yours to own rather than to rent. The
client work is the same discipline applied to someone else's business - hand-written
HTML, CSS and JS (React only when a site genuinely needs it), SEO handled as the site
is built, hosting set up in the client's own account, and the code, repository and
domain owned outright by the client.

The site itself carries no third-party scripts, analytics or cookie banner. Content is
published in English, Dutch (/nl/) and German (/de/); the three are translations of one
another, not separate offers.

## Services

- [Websites for business](https://www.veyago.cloud/websites/): Fixed-price websites for small business - landing pages from $699 / €750 excl. tax, multi-page business sites, SEO, and the dashboards, CRMs and admin tools behind them. Packages, what costs extra, process and FAQ are all on the page.
- [Product and app work](https://www.veyago.cloud/services/): Design and engineering for people building a product rather than a marketing site.
- [Our approach](https://www.veyago.cloud/approach/): The principles the work is held to - privacy by design, on-device where it can be, no dark patterns, fair pricing, yours to own.

## Apps

- [Kept](https://www.veyago.cloud/kept/): A private, on-device tracker for warranties, receipts, documents, subscriptions and expiry dates. iOS. No accounts, no servers, nothing leaves the device.
- [Veyago travel](https://www.veyago.cloud/veyago/): A travel app that turns "where should we go?" into a decision - a bracket tournament for destinations, solo or with a group - then plans the trip. iOS and Android.
- [All apps](https://www.veyago.cloud/apps/): What every app in the catalogue is held to, and where each one stands.

## Research and writing

- [Projects](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/): The research that comes before a build, and where each idea sits in the pipeline.
- [The Unkept Life](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/the-unkept-life/): The research behind Kept - the cognitive cost of personal life administration, and why a private, on-device answer is now possible.
- [The Edge Moves In](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/the-edge-moves-in/): On-device inference and what moves off the cloud as consumer hardware catches up.
- [Articles](https://www.veyago.cloud/journal/): Build logs, research notes and the occasional opinion from the studio.
